feature_flags_values_check.name: feature_flags_values_check
feature_flags_values_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags") = 'object'
    and "feature_flags"."flags" ?& array['retrieval_vector','retrieval_keyword','retrieval_entity','retrieval_time','memory_gate','decay','reranker','authority_resolution','read_time_resolution','read_time_reinforcement']
    and ("feature_flags"."flags" - array['retrieval_vector','retrieval_keyword','retrieval_entity','retrieval_time','memory_gate','decay','reranker','authority_resolution','read_time_resolution','read_time_reinforcement']) = '{}'::jsonb
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'retrieval_vector') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'retrieval_keyword') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'retrieval_entity') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'retrieval_time') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'memory_gate') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'decay') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'reranker') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'authority_resolution') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'read_time_resolution') = 'boolean'
    and jsonb_typeof("feature_flags"."flags"->'read_time_reinforcement') = 'boolean'

memory_tasks_lease_check.name: memory_tasks_lease_check

memory_tasks_payload_check.name: memory_tasks_payload_check
memory_tasks_payload_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("memory_tasks"."payload") = 'object' and (
    ("memory_tasks"."type" in ('DECAY','COMPILE_PROFILE') and "memory_tasks"."payload" = '{}'::jsonb) or
    ("memory_tasks"."type" = 'EXTRACT' and "memory_tasks"."payload" ? 'evidence_id' and "memory_tasks"."payload" - 'evidence_id' = '{}'::jsonb and
      jsonb_typeof("memory_tasks"."payload"->'evidence_id') = 'string' and "memory_tasks"."payload"->>'evidence_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') or
    ("memory_tasks"."type" = 'REEMBED' and "memory_tasks"."payload" ? 'belief_version_id' and "memory_tasks"."payload" - 'belief_version_id' = '{}'::jsonb and
      jsonb_typeof("memory_tasks"."payload"->'belief_version_id') = 'string' and "memory_tasks"."payload"->>'belief_version_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  )

model_usage_scope_check.name: model_usage_scope_check
model_usage_scope_check.value: "model_usage"."conversation_id" is null or "model_usage"."project_id" is not null
